YouTube Video Subtitle — Add Subtitles to YouTube Videos (v1.0.0)

- Initial release enabling subtitle generation (English & Japanese) for YouTube videos with cloud-based captioning.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB; returns edited video in about 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic backend session and token setup with clear user feedback ("Connecting...", "Ready!").
- Built-in workflows for video upload, subtitle editing, export, credit check, and error handling.
- Compatible with timeline editing, multiple tracks (video, audio, text), and supports iterative or batch edits.
- Requires no manual transcription or complex software—ideal for YouTubers seeking quick, accurate captions.
